capture_comparison: Release/sanitizer captures match each other and the prior qualified original loading-bar hash; release capture inspected. No original marked-atlas, Frame/login or world capture.

prior_failures.result: Compilation succeeded; 30/31 CTest checks passed; image fixture exited 1: Loose image unexpectedly read packages.
prior_failures.cause: The fixture submitted a package-only request before asserting zero package reads during disk-only loading; the retained worker correctly executed that independent queued read.
prior_failures.correction: Construct the package-only handle after the completed disk assertion. No implementation or sanitizer change.
prior_failures.remaining_jobs: Superseded sanitizer jobs were cancelled and are not qualified.

review_correction: Before qualification, restored original immediate atlas uploads: legacy Gx dirty rectangles replace rather than accumulate. The fixture completes twelve member uploads before drawing to check all cells survive.
contracts: TextureCreate interprets explicit/default sampler, disk eligibility, atlas eligibility, exact BLP suffix and UI priority; streaming/unsupported bits fail.

Optional canonical read-only loose root is checked before packages only for disk-eligible requests. Absence allows package lookup; ambiguity, escaping symlinks, nonregular files, read/decode failures do not.
Cache identity includes source eligibility, atlas representation and explicit/default sampler policy. Priority-only duplicates retain handle identity and promote queued work.

Atlas creation starts disabled. Marked BLPs (header 0x10), square dimensions <=64 and nearest/linear clamped sampling share an 8x8 sheet. Mip/repeat, unmarked and other dimensions retain standalone storage.
Original atlas offset/scale and member dimensions remain distinct from sheet storage; slots clear/recycle, siblings survive close, and final close retires GPU bindings before pixels.
Whole-sheet callback pixels and image levels share the 256 MiB retained budget; no legacy bit15 partial-source or CAsyncObject ABI is fabricated.
Original default LinearMipNearest is configurable; default-policy small single-level BLPs select nearest. Explicit mip requests still require complete authored chains.
Owner-thread cache/handle/GPU mutation, retained worker reads/decode and consumer-before-service/device/context/queue shutdown remain required.
qualification_limits: Shared-atlas pixels, source overrides and default-filter checks are authored evidence. Original loading-bar 0x17 acceptance remains standalone; original Elwynn authored-mip minification is a resource regression, not world rendering.

Atlas surface is single-level clamped nearest/linear; broader original atlas/mip/compressed-source callbacks, TGA/alternate-format lookup, basename aliases, substitutions, anisotropy and remote streaming remain unavailable.
Actual CScriptRegion/CSimpleRegion/CSimpleFontString/CSimpleTexture/CSimpleTop/CRenderBatch consumers, deferred destruction, SDL size invalidation and image-mode shader qualification remain open.
Full signed ordered FrameXML/GlueXML execution, post-creation digest comparison, actual original login, portable transport/authentication and observed GrimGuzzler world entry remain open.
No new physical-input, Windows runtime, macOS graphics/desktop, server session, Warden or gameplay acceptance. M3 is incomplete.
